The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's unsupported claim, in its ledger at step 12, that "we have identified the first National Geographic short on YouTube." The search results at step 11 only showed that "Human Origins 101" matched a #9 query among other National Geographic videos. Nothing in the log established that it was the first short. Every later step, including the search for #9 in that video, the Assistant's instruction, and the step-25 fact sheet that listed it as a "given or verified fact," built on this premise. The lead toward the Monterey Bay Aquarium's deep-sea animal content, which surfaced at step 56, was never followed up.
